title: Formalising Gödel's incompleteness theorems using the theory of hereditarily finite sets in the Lean theorem prover.

source.citation: S. Swierczkowski, Finite sets and Goedel's incompleteness theorems, Dissertationes Mathematicae 422 (2003), 1-58
source.scope: First incompleteness theorem part (HF theory, coding, Pf formula, first incompleteness); second theorem not covered
source.evidence: README: 'The work closely follows S. Swierczkowski's Finite Sets and Goedel's Incompleteness Theorems'; abstract.tex: 'the work follows the developments by \cite{swierczkowski2003finite}'. Paper is 58 pp; scope estimate ~40 pp (everything up to first incompleteness). Not on arXiv.
